items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: They had three sax, and Nathaniel Story played trombone. Oh yeah. Dewey Jackson played trumpet.

ctx.x: He played saxophone, alto saxophone and baritone. And his brother-in-law played alto saxophone and baritone. They had three sax, and Nathaniel Story played trombone. Oh yeah. Dewey Jackson played trumpet. And, any other trumpets? I'm trying to think of other trumpets. First, second trumpet. Oh, Irvin Randolph. Oh yeah. Irvin Randolph. Yeah, I knew him in Chicago, yeah. Yes.
He worked with Louis Armstrong up there. That's right.
